decisions.reason: Bowl-surround lighting is owned by the separate decorative-lighting Requirement; the existing premium DJ-style identity remains valid unchanged.
The candidate already records the same-message control styling, while bowl-surround lighting is an independent decorative-lighting behavior.
Adding lights around the bowls does not change the established beige and green color requirements.
Bowl-surround lighting does not alter machine names, logos, text, or placard placement.
The lighting request does not change bowl capacity, depth, or form.
Decorative lighting does not change the required mixing texture, foam quality, or high-speed behavior.
The source does not establish any change to maintenance access or serviceability.
Lights around the bowls do not change dispensing controls, valve operation, or flow behavior.
The decorative-lighting addition does not change spout geometry, construction, orientation, or pour direction.
The newly required lights around the bowls add a physical feature that the finalized system layout must represent.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The initial renderings that I sent you are all AI generated. The proportions of an AI picture aren’t going to match with what can actually be made. With that said, if a new base is to built, I like the buttons and knobs on the renderings. I would like for them to be silver like a DJ booth. I would like lights and the measuring units around the bowls. 

Also, I like the power button in the renderings. You mentioned putting a K on the buttons earlier. I would like to explore that. 

Karla Burton

decisions.reason: The added electrical lighting feature must be accounted for in the device wiring plan, without prescribing a particular circuit design.
